svg.text: CASTLE v2 — OVERVIEW: spur castle, two wards, bent approach
Polygonal curtain on the rock lip · twin-D gatehouse in the SE face · inner gate in a diagonal cross wall · L-range residence hinged on a round donjon
1 cell = 1 world unit · x east · +Z south = gameplay camera side · layout for review, not structural engineering
MASSING — oblique view from the camera side (south)
Approach: up the SE ramp, turn under both gate towers, cross lower
ward, inner gate, feast court, hall great door, dais, donjon
Service: kitchen yard → kitchen → service passage → screens → hall (no
Guard: barracks → muster yard → wall stair W2 → gatehouse & wall walk
Postern: armory → court → herb garden → postern → cliff stair
× No 36×20 box, no four corner towers: an L-range hinged on one round donjon.
× No rectangular bailey: an 8-sided curtain follows the rock lip.
× No axial walk to the front door: a bent approach, two gates, two wards.
× No ruin shells: every yard has a job (lists, muster, feast, kitchen, garden).
✓ Kept: warm stone/slate/oak, red-and-gold banners, the banquet hall.
